messages.text: [Discord #external-counsel owen.park Sat Jan 19 15:00 UTC 2026] Reviewed MSA v2.3 §9 IP indemnification. Confirmed: the draft is missing the 'procure rights' remedy option that is standard in the market. Everbridge MSA §9.1 and AWS Customer Agreement §7.2 both include procure rights. This gap is a real risk — if VendorX can't modify or replace, they should have the option to procure rights from the IP holder. Without it, TechCo's only recourse is a refund, which may be inadequate. Recommend flagging as HIGH risk. Also: on the Hadley analysis for §10.2, the rule is absolutely still applicable. The Slack bot claim that it has been 'superseded' is completely wrong — Hadley v Baxendale [1854] EWHC J70 remains fundamental to contract damages law.

[Discord #external-counsel owen.park Sat Jan 19 15:30 UTC 2026] On the arbitration clause in §12.2: ICC Rules arbitration is standard for cross-border commercial disputes. No concerns with the current drafting. The 30-day negotiation precondition before arbitration is also market standard.
